nodes.label: POST /email/resend-request-for-quotation/{rfq_number}/{vendor_batch}/{vendor_code} - Manually Resend RFQ
nodes.rationale: Dual-vendor RFQs are modelled with vendor_batch 1 (primary) and 2 (secondary), where batch 2 is only processed if batch 1 declined; the endpoint therefore runs per-item dual-vendor validation before resending so a secondary vendor is not contacted prematurely.

edges.source_location: near-duplicate operations with identical path parameter triples and identical dual-vendor validation description, differing only by an added source_vendor body; no $ref links them
